result.fix: Run `df -h /var/lib/acme` to see the volume. If `/dev/mapper/rl-var` is an LVM volume, grow it with `lvextend -r -L +2G /dev/mapper/rl-var`. Otherwise grow the volume, or point the install at a larger disk.
result.message: `/var/lib/acme` has 22 GiB free on `/var` (ext4). 24 GiB is recommended and 20 GiB is the least.
